done_when.criterion: The single HTML file contains separate, linked sections for Menu, Hours, Location, Pre-order, Gallery and Farm stories
The Menu section lists items in categories, with each price shown or marked as a placeholder
The Hours section lists opening times for every day of the week, or marked placeholders
The Location section shows the cafe name, an Indiranagar, Bengaluru address (or marked placeholder) and an embedded or linked map
The Pre-order section has a form where a visitor picks menu items and quantities, enters name, phone number and pickup time, and sees an order summary with a total before submitting
The Gallery section holds at least 12 image slots with alt text, lazy loading, and a way to view each image larger

The Farm stories section has three separate entries, one per coffee farm, each with a heading, a multi-paragraph story area, and image slots, with farm names and facts as marked placeholders where unknown
The page is responsive: it has a viewport meta tag and CSS rules that adapt the layout for narrow screens
The file needs no build step and loads any external library only from a CDN
Every unsupplied fact is visibly marked as a placeholder in the page
